text:
jamie chen: quick sync — NimbleHealth renewal POC finished yesterday. Perf is fine for short bursts but sustained throughput on longer seqs blew past their expected token budget. they want a pricing rebaseline before renewal talks next week.

alex ramos: can you drop the POC numbers? concurrent qps / 90th-latency / tokens per month?

jamie chen: sure — POC summary: 500 qps burst test, 90p latency 180ms, sustained load sim averaged 60 qps and consumed ~1.2B tokens over 14 days. they expected 400M tokens for the same window.

alex ramos: hm that's ~3x forecast. likely due to longer context + aggressive retry logic on their side. sending current rate card + commit uplift calc.

maria singh: @jamie chen @alex ramos I can propose a staged uplift: commit to 1.5B tokens for next 12 months with a stepped discount (15% first quarter, 10% after) and a safety burst buffer. need deal desk signoff for nonstandard tier.

oliver park: FYI NimbleHealth also filed a security questionnaire in the POC — SSO + HIPAA scoping. legal flagged a data residency clause they want clarified before an annual commit.

jamie chen: noted. timeline: renewal negotiation window opens Mon; need pricing + legal OK by EOD Friday.

dealbot: docs: https://redwood.example/sales/ratecards/current  — suggested uplift calc: 
```
base_commit = 500000000
observed_usage = 1200000000
recommended_commit = ceil(observed_usage * 1.25) = 1500000000
pricing_delta = (recommended_commit - base_commit) * effective_rate
```

maria singh: adding a one-time migration credit to help offset their overage exposure makes the ask easier. propose $25k credit conditional on signed 12-mo commit.

legal-bot: Quick check: if we add the migration credit we need fields: credit amount, application window (90 days), non-refundable clause, and approval from Legal. I can draft the amendment but need the security decision on residency.

alex ramos: to speed approval, here's a compact proposal for Deal Desk: 
- Customer: NimbleHealth
- Current commit: 500M tokens/year
- Observed (POC): 1.2B tokens / 14 days -> extrapolate monthly
- Proposed commit: 1.5B tokens/year (12-mo)
- Discount: effective blended 12%
- One-time credit: $25k applied to first invoice
- Conditions: security residency approved OR fallback to encrypted-in-transit only

jamie chen: can someone pull the pricing impact calc (rev delta vs ARR) and stub a deal desk ticket? I don't want to manually format.

cs_lead: I'll open the ticket. tagging @maria singh for discount rationale and @legal-bot for amendment. ETA for ticket: 2 hours.

maria singh: I'll upload the POC metrics and my discount rationale to the ticket. also recommending a canary roll for traffic shift — reduce risk. :thumbsup:

oliver park: on security, NimbleHealth asked about a private deployment option (VPC) if residency can't be met. That changes pricing materially — flagging to Sales and Legal.

jamie chen: thanks all. action items: 
- cs_lead: create deal desk ticket + attach POC artifacts (2h)
- maria singh: prepare discount memo + uplift calc (EOD)
- legal-bot: prepare amendment draft + residency options (EOD)
- alex ramos: provide ARR impact calc (EOD)
- oliver park: scope VPC price delta and timeline

alex ramos: ping if you want me to join the call with NimbleHealth next Tue — can walk through the commit math.

jamie chen: yes please. thanks everyone — will report back once Deal Desk responds. :white_check_mark:
